---


### **Events:**
 - **ready** - Fired once after the first live build (core, SPEC §6.3), on the microtask after it; also the `ready` attribute, `:state(ready)`, `isReady` and `whenReady()`. Twin callback `onReady`.
- **input-rejected** - Fired when a written value is refused (core, SPEC §6): an invalid attribute or property value, or an unknown `setAttributes()` key. The element warns and keeps its previous value. Detail `{ configKey, attribute?, value, reason?, kept, source }`. Twin callback `onInputRejected`.

### **Methods:**
 

- **whenReady(): _Promise<void>_** - Resolves once the first build is live (also settles when the element is destroyed first). Never rejects.
- **release(): _void_** - Build an element held by `defer` (SPEC §6.3), with everything assigned meanwhile.
- **setAttributes(values: _Record<string, unknown>_): _InputRejection[]_** - Apply many inputs (by configKey or attribute name) as ONE rebuild / update. Returns the values it refused (each also fires `input-rejected`).
- **batch(fn: _() => void_): _void_** - Run `fn` and coalesce every input change it makes into one rebuild / update.
- **flush(): _void_** - Apply pending input writes synchronously, now (SPEC §12.7).
- **whenSettled(): _Promise<void>_** - Resolves once every staged input change has been applied (SPEC §12.7).
- **destroy(): _void_** - Final teardown (SPEC §6.5): the element is inert afterwards; idempotent.
- **enableLogging(level: _LogLevelDesc_): _void_** - Set this element's own log level (default `debug`): it logs that level and above, whatever its component type or the page is set to.
- **disableLogging(): _void_** - Silence this element (its own level = `silent`).
- **resetLogging(): _void_** - Clear this element's own log level: it follows its component type / the page again.
- **checkValidity(): _boolean_** - Form validity check (SPEC §6.6).
- **reportValidity(): _boolean_** - Form validity check that reports to the user (SPEC §6.6).






- **bindToStore(storeEl: _DropzoneElement_): _void_** - Programmatically bind to a `<web-dropzone>` element, bypassing the
`for=` attribute. Use when mounting the satellite inside another
shadow root (where `document.getElementById` can't reach the store).

Safe to call before the element connects — the binding is used when it
activates. Calling after connection tears down the current wiring and
re-binds.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: Id of the `<web-dropzone>` store this satellite binds to (attribute `for`). Changing it re-binds. Not needed when the store mounts the satellite itself.

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: This satellite's own UI strings — a partial `DropzoneLabels` (property, or a JSON attribute), merged per key over the bound store's `labels`, then the built-in English. Live.

attributes.name: custom-styles
attributes.description: Extra CSS for this satellite's shadow root (raw CSS — NOT sanitized). Comes after the page-wide `window.components[tag].customStyles`, so it overrides it; `getCustomStylesCallback` wins over it.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Where the chip sits: fixed to a viewport edge (right, left, top, bottom) or inline in the page flow.

attributes.name: drawer
attributes.description: `auto`: the chip is a button opening a slide-out drawer with the full file list; `off`: a non-interactive `role="status"` chip, no drawer.

attributes.name: defer
attributes.description: Hold the first build (core, SPEC §6.3): while set when the element first connects, nothing is built and every input, callback and listener assigned meanwhile accumulates; `release()` (or removing the attribute) then builds once. Latched after the first build.

attributes.name: theme-source

### **Events:**
 - **ready** - Fired once after the first live build (core, SPEC §6.3), on the microtask after it; also the `ready` attribute, `:state(ready)`, `isReady` and `whenReady()`. Twin callback `onReady`.
- **input-rejected** - Fired when a written value is refused (core, SPEC §6): an invalid attribute or property value, or an unknown `setAttributes()` key. The element warns and keeps its previous value. Detail `{ configKey, attribute?, value, reason?, kept, source }`. Twin callback `onInputRejected`.

### **Methods:**
 
- **whenReady(): _Promise<void>_** - Resolves once the first build is live (also settles when the element is destroyed first). Never rejects.
- **release(): _void_** - Build an element held by `defer` (SPEC §6.3), with everything assigned meanwhile.
- **setAttributes(values: _Record<string, unknown>_): _InputRejection[]_** - Apply many inputs (by configKey or attribute name) as ONE rebuild / update. Returns the values it refused (each also fires `input-rejected`).
- **batch(fn: _() => void_): _void_** - Run `fn` and coalesce every input change it makes into one rebuild / update.
- **flush(): _void_** - Apply pending input writes synchronously, now (SPEC §12.7).
- **whenSettled(): _Promise<void>_** - Resolves once every staged input change has been applied (SPEC §12.7).
- **destroy(): _void_** - Final teardown (SPEC §6.5): the element is inert afterwards; idempotent.
- **enableLogging(level: _LogLevelDesc_): _void_** - Set this element's own log level (default `debug`): it logs that level and above, whatever its component type or the page is set to.
- **disableLogging(): _void_** - Silence this element (its own level = `silent`).
- **resetLogging(): _void_** - Clear this element's own log level: it follows its component type / the page again.
- **checkValidity(): _boolean_** - Form validity check (SPEC §6.6).
- **reportValidity(): _boolean_** - Form validity check that reports to the user (SPEC §6.6).







- **bindToStore(storeEl: _DropzoneElement_): _void_** - Programmatically bind to a `<web-dropzone>` element, bypassing the
`for=` attribute. Use when mounting the satellite inside another
shadow root (where `document.getElementById` can't reach the store).

Safe to call before the element connects — the binding is used when it
activates. Calling after connection tears down the current wiring and
re-binds.

---


### **Events:**
 - **ready** - Fired once after the first live build (core, SPEC §6.3), on the microtask after it; also the `ready` attribute, `:state(ready)`, `isReady` and `whenReady()`. Twin callback `onReady`.
- **input-rejected** - Fired when a written value is refused (core, SPEC §6): an invalid attribute or property value, or an unknown `setAttributes()` key. The element warns and keeps its previous value. Detail `{ configKey, attribute?, value, reason?, kept, source }`. Twin callback `onInputRejected`.

### **Methods:**
 



- **openFileDialog(): _void_** - Open the native file dialog, as a click on the picker would. No-op while
disabled or before the picker has rendered (not bound to a store yet).
- **whenReady(): _Promise<void>_** - Resolves once the first build is live (also settles when the element is destroyed first). Never rejects.
- **release(): _void_** - Build an element held by `defer` (SPEC §6.3), with everything assigned meanwhile.
- **setAttributes(values: _Record<string, unknown>_): _InputRejection[]_** - Apply many inputs (by configKey or attribute name) as ONE rebuild / update. Returns the values it refused (each also fires `input-rejected`).
- **batch(fn: _() => void_): _void_** - Run `fn` and coalesce every input change it makes into one rebuild / update.
- **flush(): _void_** - Apply pending input writes synchronously, now (SPEC §12.7).
- **whenSettled(): _Promise<void>_** - Resolves once every staged input change has been applied (SPEC §12.7).
- **destroy(): _void_** - Final teardown (SPEC §6.5): the element is inert afterwards; idempotent.
- **enableLogging(level: _LogLevelDesc_): _void_** - Set this element's own log level (default `debug`): it logs that level and above, whatever its component type or the page is set to.
- **disableLogging(): _void_** - Silence this element (its own level = `silent`).
- **resetLogging(): _void_** - Clear this element's own log level: it follows its component type / the page again.
- **checkValidity(): _boolean_** - Form validity check (SPEC §6.6).
- **reportValidity(): _boolean_** - Form validity check that reports to the user (SPEC §6.6).






- **bindToStore(storeEl: _DropzoneElement_): _void_** - Programmatically bind to a `<web-dropzone>` element, bypassing the
`for=` attribute. Use when mounting the satellite inside another
shadow root (where `document.getElementById` can't reach the store).

Safe to call before the element connects — the binding is used when it
activates. Calling after connection tears down the current wiring and
re-binds.

### **Events:**
 - **ready** - Fired once after the first live build (core, SPEC §6.3), on the microtask after it; also the `ready` attribute, `:state(ready)`, `isReady` and `whenReady()`. Twin callback `onReady`.
- **input-rejected** - Fired when a written value is refused (core, SPEC §6): an invalid attribute or property value, or an unknown `setAttributes()` key. The element warns and keeps its previous value. Detail `{ configKey, attribute?, value, reason?, kept, source }`. Twin callback `onInputRejected`.

### **Methods:**
 
- **whenReady(): _Promise<void>_** - Resolves once the first build is live (also settles when the element is destroyed first). Never rejects.
- **release(): _void_** - Build an element held by `defer` (SPEC §6.3), with everything assigned meanwhile.
- **setAttributes(values: _Record<string, unknown>_): _InputRejection[]_** - Apply many inputs (by configKey or attribute name) as ONE rebuild / update. Returns the values it refused (each also fires `input-rejected`).
- **batch(fn: _() => void_): _void_** - Run `fn` and coalesce every input change it makes into one rebuild / update.
- **flush(): _void_** - Apply pending input writes synchronously, now (SPEC §12.7).
- **whenSettled(): _Promise<void>_** - Resolves once every staged input change has been applied (SPEC §12.7).
- **destroy(): _void_** - Final teardown (SPEC §6.5): the element is inert afterwards; idempotent.
- **enableLogging(level: _LogLevelDesc_): _void_** - Set this element's own log level (default `debug`): it logs that level and above, whatever its component type or the page is set to.
- **disableLogging(): _void_** - Silence this element (its own level = `silent`).
- **resetLogging(): _void_** - Clear this element's own log level: it follows its component type / the page again.
- **checkValidity(): _boolean_** - Form validity check (SPEC §6.6).
- **reportValidity(): _boolean_** - Form validity check that reports to the user (SPEC §6.6).







- **bindToStore(storeEl: _DropzoneElement_): _void_** - Programmatically bind to a `<web-dropzone>` element, bypassing the
`for=` attribute. Use when mounting the satellite inside another
shadow root (where `document.getElementById` can't reach the store).

activates. Calling after connection tears down the current wiring and
re-binds.

elements.name: web-dropzone
elements.description:
DropzoneElement - <web-dropzone> custom element

---


### **Events:**
 - **file-add** - A file entered the dropzone (one event per file). `detail`: `{ file }`. Twin: `onFileAdd(detail)`.
- **file-remove** - A file left the list — LOCAL, client-side (row ✕, `removeFile(s)`, Clear all, a single-file replace, a mode-flip rebuild); one event per file. A running upload is cancelled first. Compare `file-delete`. `detail`: `{ file }`. Twin: `onFileRemove(detail)`.
- **files-change** - Coalesced "queue updated" tick, at most once per animation frame. `detail`: `{ changedIds, files }`. Twin: `onFilesChange(detail)`.
- **change** - The selection changed (add / remove / clear). `detail`: `{ files }`. Twin: `onChange(detail)`.
- **file-reject** - Files failed validation, or `beforeFilesAddCallback` vetoed the add (code `rejected`). `detail`: `{ rejectedFiles: [{ file, validation: { valid, error, code } }] }`. Twin: `onFileReject(detail)`.
- **file-retry** - A failed / cancelled file was re-queued (status already `pending`). `detail`: `{ file }`. Twin: `onFileRetry(detail)`.
- **file-upload** - `uploadFileCallback` resolved for a file. `detail`: `{ file }`. Twin: `onFileUpload(detail)`.
- **file-delete** - SERVER state: a removed file had server-side state (upload completed, or metadata stashed via `setMetadata`) — fires right after its `file-remove`; wire your server DELETE here. `detail`: `{ file }`. Twin: `onFileDelete(detail)`.
- **file-cancel** - A cancel finished. `detail`: `{ file, result: 'cancelled' | 'timeout-error' | 'timeout-remove', uploadedBytes, metadata }`. Server-side cleanup of a partial upload is the app's job. Twin: `onFileCancel(detail)`.
- **file-progress** - A file's progress changed. `detail`: `{ id, progress, status, file }`. Twin: `onFileProgress(detail)`.
- **file-status-change** - A file's status transitioned. `detail`: `{ id, oldStatus, newStatus, file }`. Twin: `onFileStatusChange(detail)`.
- **file-update** - A file field other than progress / status changed (preview generated, upload result merged). `detail`: `{ file }`. Twin: `onFileUpdate(detail)`.
- **overlay-enter** - A drag entered the drag overlay (`overlay-target`). `detail`: `{ overlayElement }`. Twin: `onOverlayEnter(detail)`.
- **overlay-leave** - A drag left the drag overlay. `detail`: `{ overlayElement }`. Twin: `onOverlayLeave(detail)`.

events.description: Core lifecycle event: fired ONCE, after the first build (the store is live, `el.controller` works). A later rebuild (mode flip) or a DOM move does not fire it again. The host gets the `ready` attribute and `:state(ready)`; `await el.whenReady()` is the promise form. Hold the first build with the `defer` attribute and `release()`. `detail`: `controller` / `element`. Twin: `onReady(detail)`.

events.name: input-rejected
events.description: Fired when a written value is refused (core, SPEC §6): an invalid attribute or property value, or an unknown `setAttributes()` key. The element warns and keeps its previous value. Detail `{ configKey, attribute?, value, reason?, kept, source }`. Twin callback `onInputRejected`.
